rationale: Mass-based volume: 250,000 kg / 750 kg/m3 = 333.33 m3. Dimension-based volume: pi * (4)^2 * 15 = pi * 16 * 15 = 753.98 m3. Dimension-based (754) is much larger than mass-based (333). - large_deal: >= 60,000
